svg.title: Qodo software factory implementation status - November 10, 2026
svg.desc: Separate status overlay on the v12 architecture. Partial pilots are distinguished from complete architecture capabilities. Green callouts identify specific reported working capabilities. Thought-of, explicit gaps and unconfirmed areas remain separate. This is not a current-runtime or production-readiness audit.

g.text: HUMAN PLANE / SET DIRECTION, AUTHOR DEFINITIONS, OBSERVE AND GOVERN
Author files; observe and govern changes.
Set permissions, budgets and escalation rights.
One evidence layer for human oversight and automatic factory improvement.
Traces · tool calls · cost · latency · retries
Work package + artifact revisions · Session + context references · Environment fingerprint
Policy + verifier versions · Evidence + verdict · Authorized action · Freshness + outcomes
Failure replay → candidate protected reference cases
VERIFICATION-CHANGE GATE / CHANGES TO THE CHECKER ARE WORK PACKAGES
Intent + contracts · Valid / invalid behaviors · Reproduced failures · Coverage / risk deltas
Criteria changes require separately authorized acceptance. Different model ≠ independent authority or evidence.
authorized verifier version → active verification pressure
Turn demand into candidate work for triage.
AI review · Risk judges · Behavioral evals
Turn findings into the next iteration.
Crashes · Bugs · CVEs · Drift · Codebase health
Turn observed software health into corrective action.
Hold / halt · flag off · isolate. Restore
VERSIONED WORK PACKAGE / SHARED ACROSS DELIVERY
Outcome · risk · owner · scope · required proof
corrective work → reprioritize, rescope or repair
agent guidance + factory policy · memory / runtime I/O
Agent guidance + factory control, as files
Keep evidence, hypotheses and accepted lessons distinct.
Domain knowledge; scoped and kept current
Extract hypotheses; retain the source record
Retrieve scoped knowledge into working memory.
Raw traces remain linked; summaries are derived views.
Replaceable agents, tools and governed environments
Evidence records the environment used for each run.
Shared telemetry, agent runs, findings, production
Link incidents to sessions, retrieved context,
checks and environment versions. Test causal
Suggest or configure agents, tools and runtimes.
Changed checks use the separate adoption gate
Canary and compare outcomes. Contain failures;
restore only when safe. Record outcomes in
candidate verifier version → independent adoption gate
configure / inspect agent roles, tools + runtimes
read / write memory · validate durable knowledge
Governed improvement: SWF changes are versioned, independently evaluated and reversible. Authority expands through explicit human decisions.

g.title: Human approval and identity boundaries are real; the complete machine-enforced acceptance/authority model is not established.
Session/PR visibility and a decision-review POC exist; a unified outcome/quality/audit layer is not confirmed.
Task progress is recorded, but full trace retention, context lineage and metrics coverage are not established.
No complete factory quality/outcome metrics implementation is established; early agent-interaction metrics were explicitly not tracked.
Existing telemetry tools are mentioned; integrated factory dashboards and policy audit coverage are not demonstrated.
The live decision ledger POC uses PR-history and cross-repo evidence. Package/policy/verifier/environment lineage and freshness are not shown end to end.
The production-to-session learning and repair flow is discussed/proposed; a shipped closed loop is not demonstrated.

g.aria-label: Incident replay and diagnosis: THOUGHT OF
g.title: The production-to-session learning and repair flow is discussed/proposed; a shipped closed loop is not demonstrated.
The production-to-session learning and repair flow is discussed/proposed; a shipped closed loop is not demonstrated.
The production-to-session learning and repair flow is discussed/proposed; a shipped closed loop is not demonstrated.
Protected reference evaluation and separately authorized checker adoption are architecture intent, with no completed implementation established.
Slack/ticket requests reach coding agents; complete customer-demand discovery and prioritization are not established.
Local tests, Qodo review and browser-validation skills exist. Comprehensive protected behavior/security/risk evaluation is not established.
Monitoring/repair PR activity is reported. The deployment-aware, durable health/repair/recheck integration is a new proposal.
Agent handoff, information triage and task routing were demonstrated. Complete eligibility/priority/acceptance governance is not established.
PR creation, tests and reusable local environments were reported working; this does not establish all bounded recovery/isolation guarantees.
Qodo reviews, decision review and walkthrough evidence exist; independent authority and protected acceptance across the complete work package are not demonstrated.
Human review/release gates exist. Automatic PR approval is planned, not demonstrated in the reported workflow.
Monitoring and existing release gates are described; automated deployment-aware repair and recovery closure remain proposed. Factory runtime CI/CD is a separate proven capability.
Matching cross-repo branches and reporting tested SHAs are in the walkthrough guidance. Full package acceptance/freshness/authorization is not established.
Named agents and bounded handoffs exist; a general governed/versioned agent pool and complete BYO surface are not established.
GitHub, Slack, Notion and review/context integrations exist. Not every integration/permission surface is complete; media publishing has an explicit gap.
Dependency setup, tests and Docker/Compose are implemented. A local service stack is not proof of representative ST/prod verification or complete isolation.
Dynamic handoffs, polling limits, persistence and runtime deployment exist. Full durable scheduling/recovery/telemetry integration is not established.
Notion sessions and persistent runtime state exist; summarization, complete context capture and retrieval lifecycle are not demonstrated.
Learning from recurring mistakes and session outcomes is a requested/planned capability; validated extraction/promotion is not shown.
PR-history/cross-repo context grounds the decision-review POC. Validated incident lessons and autonomous knowledge promotion are not established.
This discussion does not establish the implemented factory rule-file lifecycle. Qodo product availability alone is not evidence of integration in this factory.
Shared skills and the reusable browser walkthrough are concrete. The entire planning/implementation/verification/recovery procedure set and its governance are not established.
Human gates and bounded routing/identity checks exist. Auto-approval eligibility and policy-governed autonomous release are not demonstrated.
Runs and task progress are visible; autonomous optimization based on complete outcome evidence is not established.
Agent RCA and deployment health assessment are proposed; automatic causal diagnosis of factory failures is not demonstrated.
The factory maintains execution environments when dependencies change. Autonomous improvement of policies, evaluators and agent definitions is not established.
Independent evaluation of changes to the factory is blueprint intent, not a reported complete implementation.

g.aria-label: SWF rollout and learn: THOUGHT OF
g.title: Runtime deployment exists, but it does not establish autonomous improvement evaluation, outcome comparison or governed lesson adoption.

g.text: Assessment from team reports through November 10, 2026. Architecture reference: v12.
Reported working in a bounded pilot
Only part of the architecture block exists
An explicit gap in the reported workflow
The discussion does not establish status
Colored badges describe the full block. Green E1-E6 callouts identify narrower capabilities reported working.
Implementation progress ≠ current availability. This assessment does not verify live operation or production readiness.
EXPLICIT GAPS INSIDE OTHERWISE PARTIAL COMPONENTS
NOT IMPLEMENTED: workflow auto-approval of PRs; the walkthrough skill's automatic media publisher.
THOUGHT OF: the deployment-health → repair → recovery-verification loop remains a proposal.
Scope: Qodo internal factory pilot. Status is not a claim about every Qodo product or every engineering team.
